vision.text:
(You cannot win by MPPV.)
[Continuous]: Your energy attacks deal +1 life card.
[Instant] POWER: Use when one of your effects requires you to discard 1 card from your hand during combat. Draw a card and search your discard pile for 2 Styled cards and Rejuvenate them.
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack.
Search your Life Deck, discard pile, or Banished Zone for a Drill and place it into play.
DAMAGE: 6 life cards.
